Purpose: Seat a beach between dune or rainforest margins and the sea, with directionally correct wetness.

Visual brief: A thin irregular dark wet strip and pale dried wrack follow the shore; small foam remains on the water side. Black-cove foam is cream-white against cool charcoal, not a bright contour round every stone.
Geometry: proposed visual envelope only; Claude supplies exact foot, solid footprint, overhang, interaction anchors and any deck after review.
Implementation: concept only, outside the live piece library. Do not place, bake or grant gameplay until reviewed and approved.
Widths: Wet band 1-3 cells; foam is a shallow visual overlay, not a walkable strip.
Schema intake: defer the runtime material ID, palette priority and painter binding until the concept is approved; no runtime block is claimed here.
Lighting: upper-left key light; shade each material and facing for that light. The lit-picture reference is deferred until art exists.
